expanded_source_components: p.585 defines a minimum cut as a nontrivial vertex partition of minimum crossing-edge weight
p.586 fixes an ordinary undirected graph with nonnegative real edge weights
Theorem 2.1 compares a minimum s-t cut with a minimum cut after merging s and t
Lemma 3.1 proves that a maximum-adjacency phase cut is a minimum s-t cut for the last two vertices
the algorithm stores the lightest phase cut across repeated contractions
section 4 separately analyzes priority-queue running time
